question: Which of the following cricketers has written an autobiography titled ‘Six Machine’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chris Gayle**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The book “Six Machine: I Don’t Like Cricket … I Love It” is the autobiography of Jamaican cricketer Chris Gayle.
 
• **He plays international cricket for the West Indies**.
 
• He was the captain of the **West Indies team from 2007 to 2010**.
 
• He has **several records under his name across the three formats of cricket**.
 
• He is the** first-ever batsman to score 1000 sixes in T20 format**.
 
• He is the **only player to score a triplet of centuries that is a triple hundred in test, a double hundred in ODI, and a hundred in T20**.
 
• In **2019** he announced his retirement from **ODI after the 2019 cricket world cup**.
 
• **In 2014 he played his last test match against Bangladesh**.
 
• In **December 2020**, ICC included him in the T20 team of the decade.
